title: 3DYoga90: A Hierarchical Video Dataset for Yoga Pose Understanding
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of creating and benchmarking a video dataset for yoga pose understanding for AI applications, such as action recognition and pose assessment. While yoga has spiritual origins, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics in the context of AI or the yoga practices themselves. It is a technical paper on dataset creation and model performance.
